T:Slots.Contracts.ISlotEngine
member.summary: Contract a slot engine must implement to work with the simulator. The contract does not know the game rules: what pays, when a bonus triggers, and how the bet is validated are engine decisions. Every monetary value is an integer in cents.

member.name: M:Slots.Contracts.ISlotEngine.Spin(System.Int64)
member.summary: Runs a full spin: draws the outcome, evaluates wins, and runs any bonus stages that trigger. An invalid bet for the game rules must throw .

member.summary: Evaluates a spin with forced reel stops — the basis for reproducible acceptance cases. Must not consume RNG; stages that depend on draws (bonus, features) are not executed and is null.

member.name: T:Slots.Contracts.ISlotEngineFactory
member.summary: Simulator entry point: creates an engine from a seed. Same seed → same sequence of results, always.
